security concept.title: Security concept: defense in depth
security concept.content: Defense in depth uses multiple independent protective layers so that failure of one control does not expose a system by itself.

input validation.title: Input Validation Guide
input validation.content: Input validation checks untrusted input against expected types, formats, and ranges before processing. Reject invalid values and perform validation at the receiving boundary.

access control.title: Access Control Overview
access control.content: Access control decides which identities may perform which actions on resources. It checks authorization against permissions or policy after identity is established.

audit logging.title: Audit Logging Guide
audit logging.content: Audit logs record security-relevant events such as sign-ins and permission changes, including time, actor, action, and outcome. They support investigation and accountability.

secure defaults.title: Secure Defaults Reference
secure defaults.content: Secure defaults start with the least privileges and minimum features needed. Optional access is disabled until explicitly enabled.

authentication.title: Authentication Definition
authentication.content: Authentication verifies that a user, device, or service is the identity it claims to be, using evidence such as a password or security key.

data minimization.title: Data Minimization Overview
data minimization.content: Data minimization limits collection, use, and retention of personal data to what is necessary for a stated purpose.

rate limiting.title: Rate Limiting Overview
rate limiting.content: Rate limiting restricts how many requests a client can make in a defined period. It helps control abuse and resource exhaustion.

least privilege.title: Least Privilege Reference
least privilege.content: Least privilege grants users and services only the permissions needed for their assigned tasks, and removes unneeded access.

secure coding.title: Secure Coding Overview
secure coding.content: Secure coding applies practices such as input validation, safe error handling, and careful dependency management to reduce vulnerabilities in software.
